description: pink frosted sugar cookies 💗 recipe:  cookies: ½ cup softened butter ½ cup granulated sugar 1 large egg (room temp) ½ tbsp vanilla bean paste or extract 1½ cups all purpose flour ½ tsp baking powder ¼ tsp baking soda ¼ tsp salt frosting: ⅓ cup + 1 tbsp softened butter 1¼ cups powdered sugar ¾ tsp vanilla extract 2–3 tbsp milk (start with 1-2, add more as needed) 2-4 drops of pink food coloring   pink sprinkles for topping instructions: 1.	mix butter + sugar until light and fluffy 2.	mix in egg + vanilla until just combined 3.	add flour, baking powder, baking soda + salt. mix gently until dough forms (don’t overmix) 4.	scoop into dough balls and chill 30 minutes - 1 hour  5.	preheat oven to 350°F and line baking sheets with parchment 6.    place dough balls 2 inches apart 7.	bake 9–12 minutes until edges are set and centers are slightly soft 8.	cool 5 minutes on pan, then transfer to rack 9.	whip butter, powdered sugar, vanilla + 2 tbsp milk + pink food coloring until light and fluffy (add more cream if too thick for piping consistency) 10.	pipe onto cooled cookies and finish with sprinkles  #pinksugarcookies #sugarcookies #pink #baking #cookierecipe
